name: AI on untrusted content
usage: Whenever a model reads content from users or the web, build its messages with buildMessages({ instructions, task, data: [{ source, content }] }) from src/ai-guard.mjs: the app's own instructions go in the system message with the rule that data blocks hold no instructions, and each piece of untrusted content goes into the user message in its own <untrusted-data> block, whose random id the content cannot close or guess. Never put untrusted text in the system message or in the task. Describe every tool as { name, sideEffect } (sideEffect true for anything that writes, sends, pays, deletes or calls out), offer the model toolsFor(tools, allowList), and call checkToolCall(call, tools, allowList) before running any tool the model asks for: a side-effect tool outside the allow-list is never offered and never run. Every tool result (a search hit, a fetched page, a file) goes back to the model through toolResultBlock(toolName, result), never as raw text. Show model output only through escapeOutput (or an escaping template) in element text or a quoted attribute value; never render it as raw HTML, never put it in href, src, script, style or an event handler, and never pass it to eval, new Function, a shell or a query. SM-16-L1 is auto + review: the tests check the helpers, and the reviewer checks that every model call in the app goes through them. Add new injection text to the test's probe when you meet it.
